items.title: Ametria Dock interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 4, 2019
items.q: And so for years, I’ve sang with her for 16 years. So touring, I know her tics

ctx.x: Again being a background singer, you’re serving the artist. And you have to pay close attention to the way that they do what they do — the movements, the texture, the tone, matching it, understanding what they want. So a lot of the artists that I work with, but specifically to date, specifically India.Arie, our tones are alike. And so our texture and our tone and our movements are pretty much the same. So I can match her. We just did an interview the other day, we did a Sirius Radio interview. And we did a live…
